description: This file contains macro definitions and templated functions for implementing 'commit slabs', which are data structures managing slabs of memory for commit objects with customizable behavior via macros.

methods.name: init_<slabname>_with_stride
methods.description: Initializes a slab with a specified memory stride.

methods.name: init_<slabname>
methods.description: Initializes a slab with default stride 1.

methods.name: clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Clears and frees all allocated slabs.

methods.name: deep_clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Performs a deep clear of the slab with a user-provided free function for elements.

methods.name: <slabname>_at_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to an element at a given commit, optionally creating the slab if missing.

methods.name: <slabname>_at
methods.description: Returns a pointer to an element at a given commit, creating if needed.

methods.name: <slabname>_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to an element at a given commit without creating it if missing.
